question: What type of inflections are considered?
title: Copenhagen at CoNLL--SIGMORPHON 2018: Multilingual Inflection in Context with Explicit Morphosyntactic Decoding
answer_rationale: The evidence from Text 3 and Text 5 explicitly states that in Track 1 of CoNLL–SIGMORPHON 2018, context includes word forms (morphological), lemmas (morphological), and morphosyntactic descriptions (MSD, syntactic). Text 4 further confirms that all morpho-syntactic cues — including word forms, lemmas, and MSD tags — are used as context in Track 1, indicating both morphological and syntactic inflections are considered.
